rca of the issue: Reproduction: open https://cart-phase-audit.preview.emergentagent.com and wait for homepage engine. Actual: persistent wake-up screen; [data-testid='savings-engine'] never appears. Console log shows 404 for /undefined/api/health in that deployment. Probable root cause: preview runtime health/bootstrap depends on configured backend URL and/or warm backend service; missing env/warm state prevents app bootstrap. Mitigation: configure REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL in deployment and warm/restart preview, then rerun focused UI script.
